message.content: In the discussion between Li Hua and Thane Chambers, Li Hua expresses her interest in the balance of combat and puzzles in "Black Myth: Wukong." Specifically, she mentions being curious about how the game will balance the difficulty level, ensuring that there is a good mix of challenging encounters along with opportunities to strategize and utilize the powers in combat. She hopes that the game will include mechanics that reward creativity in combat, adding another layer to the gameplay and encouraging experimentation. Li Hua emphasizes the importance of balancing the game so that it remains challenging but also rewarding, providing an engaging experience for the player.
